day4_night_start.text: *I came back to the room. Locked the door and fastened the chain.*

day4_night_start_2.text: *After fastening the chain, I placed a chair in front of the door. The chair leg presses against the door and creaks.*

day4_night_start_3.text: *Under the door-lock manufacturer's sticker above the entryway, there is a small management number. A number I never saw when I moved in.*

day4_night_phone_2.text:
*Sea*

{name}, I was worried because you suddenly disappeared today

day4_night_phone_5.text:
*30 seconds later. Sea*

It's a promise.

day4_night_phone_7.text: *The next message appears before the vibration ends.*

day4_night_phone_8.text:
*10 seconds later. Sea*

Are you sleeping?

day4_night_phone_9.text:
*5 seconds later. Sea*

...Don't sleep. Just a little longer.

day4_night_phone_11.text: *No read receipt appears. I lock the screen.*

day4_night_phone_eunsu.text:
*Ms. Eunsu*

Can you come a little early tomorrow? There's something I need to talk to you about.

day4_night_phone_eunsu_3.text: *'Sleep well.' Beneath the speech bubble, the student safety app icon is floating there too.*

day4_night_phone_end.text: *I put my phone in the drawer. The vibration kept going. I wrapped it in a towel to muffle the sound.*

day4_night_save_glitch.text: *Wrapped in a towel inside the drawer, my phone starts vibrating again on its own.*

day4_night_save_glitch_2.text: *I took it out. A student safety app notification is on the screen.*

day4_night_save_glitch_3.text: *'Subje--' Flicker. The notification changes. 'Have a good night, {name}!'*

day4_night_save_glitch_4.text: *There is no entry from that same time in the notification history.*

day4_night_save_glitch_5.text: *I opened the app. It's not the usual student menu. The screen is different. White text on a black background. -- An admin panel.*

day4_night_save_glitch_6.text: ***Top of screen: 'NEVERGRAD -- Subject Management System v4.7'***

day4_night_save_glitch_7.text:
*A list appears. Thirteen rows.

#01 Kim Dojin — Terminated
#03 Park Seojin — Terminated / Day 4 escape attempt
#07 Kim Taeho — ██ response / External contact: Lee Seolhwa
#09 Han Jiho — Terminated / Day 3 early detection
...
#13 {name} — In Progress

The remaining rows are grayed out inside a collapsed menu.*

day4_night_save_glitch_8.text: *I trace all thirteen rows with my finger, from the first to the last. Of the thirteen names, twelve are marked 'Terminated.'*

day4_night_save_glitch_9.text: *I looked at the dates. The intervals aren't consistent. 3 months, 4 months, 3 months... But the duration is always the same. **5 days.***

day4_night_save_glitch_10.text: *Only #07 is different. 'Anomalous response.' External contact: Lee Seolhwa. My scrolling finger stops at Seolhwa’s name.*

day4_night_save_glitch_11.text: *#09. Han Jiho. Day 3 early detection. It ended on the third day. The processing time at the end of the row is two days earlier than the others.*

day4_night_save_glitch_13.text: *I scrolled down. There are more tabs below.*

day4_night_save_glitch_14.text: *“Location tracking history.” I tap the tab. A red dot moves across the school floor plan, tracing my movements over the past four days.*

day4_night_save_glitch_15.text: *The routes from the past four days replay at the same speed. The gate, the stairs, even the floors where I lingered are recorded in numbers.*

day4_night_save_glitch_16.text: *The permission request I tapped on Day 2 comes back to me. `Required to locate students during campus emergencies`.*

day4_night_save_glitch_17.text: *Permission list at the bottom of the screen. Allowed is ON, blocked items are gray locks. Only location is still on.*

day4_night_save_glitch_18.text: *The permission items I tapped on Day 2 are still there. Regardless of my choices, the location logs were grouped into the same line.*

day4_night_save_glitch_19.text: *The app closed. By itself. Back to the normal student menu. 'Have a good night, {name}!'*

day4_night_save_glitch_20.text: *It's the same icon. By day it showed my student QR code; at night it displays 13 rows.*

day4_night_mirror.text: *I unbuttoned two buttons on my uniform shirt. The spot where the collar button sat is red against my skin. I went to the bathroom. Turned on the sink. Washed my face.*

day4_night_mirror_2.text: *Even after I splash cold water twice more, I can’t take my hand off the edge of the sink.*

day4_night_mirror_4.text: *I have not wiped it once until now. Untouched steam covers the mirror.*

day4_night_mirror_5.text: *Drops of water run down through the fog, opening only the part at eye level first.*

day4_night_mirror_6.text: *...This time, I have to wipe it.*

day4_night_mirror_7.text: *With my palm held in front of the mirror, I can’t move as I count to two.*

day4_night_mirror_8.text:
*I hear someone behind me and turn around. Seolhwa stands at the bathroom door. Water drips from the wet sleeves of her uniform.*

Seolhwa, I couldn't wipe the mirror today either.

day4_night_mirror_9.text:
*Seolhwa looks at me without a word. Her eyes are deeply sunken.*

Why do I stop in front of the mirror every time?

day4_night_mirror_swipe.text: *I raised my hand. Placed my palm on the mirror. It's cold.*

day4_night_mirror_swipe_2.text: *I wiped slowly. Top to bottom. Once.*

day4_night_mirror_swipe_3.text: *The fog clears. My forehead is revealed.*

day4_night_mirror_swipe_5.text: *Third time. Nose. Mouth. Chin. My face is revealed.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1.text: *The mirror shows the space behind me.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_3.text: *Only the place where Seolhwa was standing a moment ago is empty.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_4.text:
You're not in the mirror. You're right behind me. Why—

*I open my mouth, but no sound comes out.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_5.text:
*I turn around, and Seolhwa is there. Water drips from the tips of her wet hair, and the skin around her eyes is wet too.*

You're standing right here. Why aren't you in the mirror?

day4_night_mirror_hit1_6.text: *I looked at the mirror again. In the mirror -- only me. Me and an empty bathroom.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_7.text:
*I look behind me: Seolhwa is there. I look in the mirror: she isn’t. I look behind me again: there she is. In the mirror, she is still absent.*

Stay still a second. I'm not imagining this.

day4_night_mirror_hit1_8.text: *Under the fluorescent light in the mirror, only empty tiles continue on.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_9.text: *Only the towel rack where Seolhwa stood is reflected in white.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_10.text: *The basement door, Seolhwa, and the record for #07 fall into the same line.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_11.text:
*I remember row #07 in the app: `External contact: Lee Seolhwa`. The section beside it was blacked out.*

Seolhwa. There was something hidden next to your name. What did it say?

day4_night_mirror_hit1_12.text:
*The mirror shows only the empty bathroom, yet Seolhwa’s wet hair is visible on the right side of my vision.*

Stop. Don't look for me in the mirror. Look here.

day4_night_mirror_hit1_13.text: *The mirror and the edge of my vision are a notch out of alignment.*

day4_night_mirror_hit1_15.text: Seolhwa. You’re talking to me, right?

day4_night_mirror_hit2.text: *My vision narrows. I stare at the mirror. My face. I look at my face.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_2.text: *For the first time in 4 days, I look properly at my face. Water drips from the tip of my chin, and only the marks of the name-tag cord remain on my neck.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_3.text: *I recall the names from the records one by one and lay them over the face in the mirror.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_4.text: *#1. Kim Dojin. Short black hair. The face -- identical.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_5.text: *#3. Park Seojin. Brown hair. The face -- identical.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_6.text: *#7. Kim Taeho. Long hair. Gaunt cheeks. But the placement of eyes, nose, mouth -- identical.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_7.text: *Different hair color. Different names. But compared to my face in the mirror -- all identical.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_8.text: *My name tag is attached to the last row.*

day4_night_mirror_hit2_9.text: *Warm coffee, a packed lunch made just right, an empty attendance box, Seolhwa absent from the mirror. All of it had been aimed at the same face.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse.text: *I stumbled backward. My back hit the wall. I slid down.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_2.text: *Graphite on my left hand. The writing on the wall. Indented strokes.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_3.text: *I slid down with my back against the wall and sat there. The chill of the tiles touched my knees.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_4.text: *Even with my teeth clenched, my jaw trembled once.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_6.text: *The graphite on my left hand grew wet and smeared.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_7.text: *The bathroom floor is cold. The ticking of the clock's second hand overlaps again and again.*

day4_night_mirror_collapse_8.text:
*Seolhwa sits beside me. Only I appear in the mirror.*

You don't have to talk. Just stay beside me.

day4_night_mirror_collapse_9.text:
*I touch the floor tiles on Seolhwa’s side. They are colder than the rest.*

The floor's this cold, but I still can't hold you, right?

day4_night_plan.text: *...Only after the chill of the tiles climbed up to the inside of my knees did I stand.*

day4_night_plan_2.text: *I looked in the mirror again. Swollen eyelids and a red nose. A drop of water rolls down beneath the name tag cord marks.*

day4_night_plan_3.text: *I opened the notebook. My hand is shaking, but I write. With my left hand. Graphite marks stain the edge of the new page.*

day4_night_plan_4.text: *One. The same face, the thirteenth name. The twelve fields before it say “Terminated.”*

day4_night_plan_5.text: *Two. Eunsu opens the door, Riin offers the cup, and Sea even knows where I will look.*

day4_night_plan_6.text: *Three. Seolhwa's trace appears beside #07. The mirror is empty, and only my left hand remembers first.*

day4_night_plan_7.text: *Four. I heard machinery and breathing beneath the old building. The empty seats are connected to the records from there, too.*

day4_night_plan_8.text: *five. Tomorrow night at 11pm. The last blank space in the attendance sheet is closed.*

day4_night_plan_9.text: *six. If it comes from the bottom, it goes up. Not the main gate, but outside the old building.*

day4_night_plan_10.text: *...I stopped writing. Put the pen down.*

day4_night_plan_11.text: *seven. Riin knows. You just don't know which door you will place your hand on.*

day4_night_plan_12.text: *eight. #03 ended up at the main gate. It cannot be the same way.*

day4_night_plan_13.text: *Nine. #07 stopped at 22:47 with Seolhwa. Thirteen minutes. That gap remains.*

day4_night_plan_14.text: *heat. #09 was caught on Day 3. The quick answer is a trap.*

day4_night_plan_15.text: *My hands tremble. The letters come out crooked. But I didn't stop.*

day4_night_plan_choice.text: *I wrote three points at the end of the note.*
choices: go out of school
send the records out
Face Eunsu

day4_night_plan_escape.text: *The front gate is a dead end. I’ll take the old wing’s emergency exit.*

day4_night_plan_expose.text: *I need to get the documents outside. If they stay in my bag, this ends here.*

day4_night_plan_confront.text: *Confront Eunsu with the record for #13 and the twelve cases before it.*

day4_night_plan_final.text: *I packed my bag. Evidence. Phone. Yuna's camera. The bare minimum.*

day4_night_plan_final_2.text: *I wrote on the last line of the notebook.*

day4_night_plan_final_3.text: ***'Twelve failures. There should not be a next line. Move before tomorrow night.'***

day4_night_plan_final_4.text: *I set the alarm. Tomorrow is the fifth day.*

day4_night_deduction_hand.text: *I rubbed the graphite on my left index finger, tracing the bent strokes from the locker and this morning’s wall.*
choices: Trace the strokes with my left hand
Recall the name tag’s typeface

day4_night_deduction_hand_match.text: *With my left hand, the strokes bent the same way. The names changed. The writing hand didn’t.*

day4_night_deduction_hand_hint.text: *A name tag has no pen strokes. I opened my left hand; graphite marked the index finger. I traced the writing against the wall.*

day4_night_deduction_seolhwa.text: *I reopened row #07 in the app: `External contact: Lee Seolhwa`. She stood before me, but the mirror showed only the towel rail.*
choices: Compare #07’s contact record with her missing reflection
Check whether the bathroom light went out

day4_night_deduction_record_match.text: *I touched the name beside #07. She had known me then. Seeing her now wasn’t proof that she was physically here.*

day4_night_deduction_record_hint.text: *The light and towel rail both had reflections. Only her place was empty. I looked from the name beside #07 to her face.*

day4_night_truth_sea_1.text: I placed the records on the desk in date order. In Sea's memo, the same food name was erased several times.

day4_night_truth_sea_2.text: I chose three notes with the same question on them.
choices: Sort by date
Read the erased answer first
Compare with this week's records

day4_night_truth_sea_3.text: The answer I guessed correctly before speaking was corrected 12 times. There was also a box where I wrote that I did not know.

day4_night_truth_sea_4.text: When I turned on the safety app, the admin panel was collapsed under my life records. It was a view-only item.

day4_night_truth_sea_choice.text: I chose from the records why Sea knew my tastes.
choices: I wrote down different answers for each previous cycle.
Only read my phone search history
From the beginning, we happened to have similar tastes.

day4_night_truth_sea_right_1.text: The same questions were dated in different years. There were twelve bundles between the first and last sheets.

day4_night_truth_sea_right_2.text: Even the leftover side dishes were written down. What Sea memorized wasn't just the correct answer.

day4_night_truth_sea_right_3.text: Next to the note, I wrote down the day I first said no and placed it next to the date I said it out loud this time.

day4_night_truth_sea_wrong_1.text: The date on the food note came before the search history.

day4_night_truth_sea_wrong_2.text: Beside the wrong answer were traces of twelve corrections.

day4_night_truth_riin_1.text: The number of medication records decreased starting from the seventh batch. There was the same signature in each space where the capacity was changed.

day4_night_truth_riin_2.text: Juxtaposing the date when Seolhwa's name disappeared and the date of his first weight loss, there was only one day between them.

day4_night_truth_riin_3.text: There was an unread separate sheet attached to the medication record.
choices: Check inventory quantity
Compare dosage signatures
Save the original you just read first.

day4_night_truth_riin_4.text: The recovery amount was written on both sides of the decrease. The medicine that escaped was calculated separately.

day4_night_truth_riin_choice.text: Why did the dosage decrease after the seventh time?
choices: After losing Seolhwa, I tried to reduce memory impairment.
This is because there was a shortage of medicine in stock.
After the experiment was over, there was no need for medication.

day4_night_truth_riin_right_1.text: There was sufficient quantity left in the inventory ledger. However, the number only went down in my prescription section.

day4_night_truth_riin_right_2.text: The note said: Damage observed. The first letter of the erased name remained below it.

day4_night_truth_riin_right_3.text: I wrote only Seolhwa's date beside Riin's signature.

day4_night_truth_riin_wrong_1.text: The number of new ampoules that arrived on the same day was written down. The explanation that there was a shortage of medicine was not correct.

day4_night_truth_riin_wrong_2.text: There was no document discontinuing the experiment. In the ongoing experiment, someone changed only the dosage.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_1.text: There was a circle in the valid column of the board report. Internal observation records noted a disposal review on the same day.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_2.text: Eunsu Teacher's signature remained on both sides. It wasn't just one incorrect document, but two different reports.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_3.text: As the date passed until the thirteenth, the word "valid" was repeated for each basis approved for the next cycle.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_4.text: After the test is over, you have to send me somewhere else. The reports kept coming up with reasons not to let me go.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_choice.text: Why did the teachers post different reports?
choices: They continued the experiment and tried to keep me in the classroom.
I did not know the contents of the document because I only lent my signature.
I was trying to get permission to graduate from the foundation.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_right_1.text: The graduation approval box was empty all 13 times. The seal of validity was the words that saved me and the words that I left behind.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_right_2.text: I closed the document and wrote down what the teacher said. It meant staying in my class until the end.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_right_3.text: I left only a blank space for the questions I'd put to her directly.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_wrong_1.text: If I didn't know the contents, I couldn't explain the revised input date. The handwriting under the signature was also the teacher's.

day4_night_truth_eunsu_wrong_2.text: The graduation approval section was never filled out. I went back to recording my internal observations.

day4_night_truth_complete_1.text: When the dates of the three records were connected in one line, it was clear who had hidden the same thing and who had changed it slightly.

day4_night_truth_complete_2.text: I folded the questions for tomorrow into separate slips for each person and tucked them away.

day4_night_truth_complete_3.text: As I wrote the last date with my left hand, Seolhwa looked at the back of my hand and nodded quietly.

day4_night_truth_partial_1.text: Dates that do not match are left blank. If I pretended to know, I couldn't ask the same question tomorrow.

day4_night_truth_partial_2.text: Only the confirmed originals were folded. I left the rest of the photos and stacked them in the order in which they would be unfolded again.

day4_history_callback_34.text: I found what I heard directly from Sea in my notebook. I wrote it down separately to see if the person who received the notification and the person whose permissions were changed were the same.

day4_history_callback_35.text: I drew a keychain that hung in the pocket of the health room. I also had to check which door the hand that had been drugged would open.

day4_history_callback_36.text: I placed the key story I wrote down next to the report. The answer that the door opens from the inside was also left along with the date.

day4_expansion_action_8_a.text: When I matched the folds on the back of the paper, I could see that even though the years were different, the questions were asked in the same order.

day4_expansion_action_8_b.text: The first answer I deleted was the sentence about liking eggs. There were more handprints left there than on the note where the correct answer was written.

day4_expansion_action_9_a.text: When I added the received quantity, the remaining amount was correct. I didn't reduce my share because of insufficient inventory.

day4_expansion_action_9_b.text: The date under the signature had been changed first. Riin corrected the figures one day before the other personnel.
